caseName: Seismograph Service Corp. v. Monaghan, Chairman, State Tax Commission
caseNameFull: Seismograph Service Corp. v. Noel Monaghan, Chairman, State Tax Commission
attorneys: Donald C. Beelar for appellant., John E. Stone for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ, of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
